title: Grateful Dead Live at Kresge Plaza, Massachusetts Institute of Technology on 1970-05-06
venue: Kresge Plaza, Massachusetts Institute of Technology
source: MSR (MIT Reels) 1/2 Track Mono -> Otari MX 55 2 track (playback) -> TC 2000 Studio Effects Processor (using only the A->D converter, no effects) ->Sonic Solutions (at 20 bits resolution) -> mastered to CD using Sony SBM 2(No DAT generations) -> CD (from Gans) > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Sharp mono soundboard captures a fiery May 6 1970 MIT set highlighted by an incendiary Dancing in the Streets and soaring Morning Dew.
ai_review.review: The recording is a mono sound‑board capture that, while a bit raw and occasionally distorted, remains clear enough to convey the band’s intense energy. The performance is widely praised – the blistering “Dancing in the Streets,” a monumental “Morning Dew,” and a ferocious “Not Fade Away” are repeatedly singled out as stand‑outs, with the whole show charged by the political climate of the time. Overall listeners describe the Dead as “in the zone,” delivering one of their most memorable early‑70s concerts.

ai_rating.rationale: The vast majority of reviews are 5‑star, praising both performance and (despite some flaws) recording clarity; the weighted average of show quality (70%) and recording quality (30%) yields a rating just above 4.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mono sound‑board feed with occasional distortion, mic dropouts, and mixing quirks, but overall clear and sharp enough to capture the band's dynamics.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: The cold weather and recent Kent State tragedy fueled a high‑octane performance; the set builds with tight transitions (e.g., China>Rider) and erupts on second‑half staples like Dancing in the Streets, delivering an angry yet exhilarating arc.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers note Jerry’s SG thrashing, perfect tone, and that he was 'in the zone' throughout.
band_member_comments.Phil: Praised for a “devastating bass run” that anchors the intense jams.
band_member_comments.Bob: Mentioned for his spoken announcement after Not Fade Away and general vocal contributions.
